book.name: Maluku
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Kuyhoka kwa Yecho

Lichiko lya Kupomolela pilijhomokila, Maliya mundo jwa ku kilambo chaku Magidala na Maliya majhe mundo Yakobu na Chalome bhajhakuhemela mahuta ghughanungila petelele na kujhenda kupaka yegha ya Yecho.
Lukala, jumapile, pulipitita lyobha, bhajhakujhenda ku mambe.
Undela bhatehila kukonyana bhene kwa bhene, “Ndi ghane jwabhilimbiye lighanga kubhoka pa nnyango jha mambe?”
Pibhalolikiya, bhajhakulibhona lighanga lela likolongwa libhilimbiwe kubhoka panyango gwa mambe.
Pibhajhingila nkate mu mambe, bhajhakumona kangombo jhumo jwawalite ngobho nhuo ya mbuu, atamite lubhoko lwalelo, na bhene bhajhakuhechuka hake.
Kangombo jhola ajhakwalobholela, “Nkotoka kuhechuka. Mipalaha Yecho jwa ku Nachalete jwakabhambitwe panane. Ayokite! Abhii jhe pambano. Nnolekehe pakagholwike.
Nnyende makalobholele bhabholwa bhake pamonga na Petile, alongolile kujhenda ku Galilaya, kwenio ndi nabhamona, ngita chabhalobholila.”
Peniya, bhajhakupita umambe jha Yecho na kubhutuka mbelo, kongo bwaghaliya na kikangacho chakamwile. Na bhene bhakalongii ndeka kwa mundo jhojhoha lilobhe lela nhwalo bhajhogwipa hake.
Yecho ampitii Maliya jwa ku kilambo cha ku Magidala
Yecho pahyokita putiputi lichiko lya jumapile, mundo jwatumbwila kumpitila akibha Maliya jwa kilambo cha Magidala, jhola jwakampihite michuka chaba.
Maliya jwa ku kilambo chaku Magidala ajhakujhenda, kwalobholela bhabholwa bhake bhubhakibha bhubhalongohina pamonga na Yecho, na bhene bhakibha bhalelita malelo.
Pubhajhohina Yecho abhi nghome na Maliya jwa Magidala akongine nako, bhene bhakajheketile ndeka.
Yecho abhapitii bhabholwa bhake bhabhele
Yecho ajhakwapetela pakate ja bhabholwa bhake bhabhele bhubhakibha bhajhahwila kuchenda. Na bhene bhakamanyitejhe.
Na bhene bhajhakubhujha, kwalobholela bhabholwa bhajhabhe. Na bhene helahela bhakajheketii ndeka.
Yecho abhapitii bhabholwa bhake kome na jhumo

Pajhomolila, Yecho ajhakwapitii bhabholwa bhake kome na jhumo bhibhakibha bhatehila kulyegha. Ajhakwapwatalila nhwalo ghane gwangajheketela kwabhe na kujhundupa kwabhe, bhajhabhe bhibhakonginika nako kuhumii mu kuyoka.
Ajhakwalobholela, “Nnyendengane mu ilambo yoha, mukalitangache Lilobhe lya Chapanga kwa bhando bhoha.
Mundo jhojhoha jwapala kujheketela na kubatichwa, Chapanga nakombola. Na mundo jhojhoha jwangajheketela kubatichwa natenda kulagha.
Na ikangacho henge nahilongohana na bhoha bhibhanyeketile. Kwa liina lyango nabhabhoha michuka, nabhalongela kwa lugha nhyono.
Na bhakamula lijhoka kwa mabhoko na kunywegha kilebhe chochoha chikibhii na uchongo, na chabhahwe ndeka. Nabhabheka mabhoko panane jha muto kwa bhibhalwalwa, na Chapanga nabhalamicha.”
Yecho atolwa kujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga
Peniya Bhambo Yecho pajhomolila kulonge nabho, ajhakutolwa kujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga. Na kutama pamonga na Chapanga mihotolo gwake.

Peniya bhabholwa bhajhakujhenda kila kimbokotole kutangacha Lilobhe lya Mbone. Bhambo ajhakuhenga lihengo pamonga na bhene, ajhakuhenga ikangacho twe, ili kulangiya lilobhe lyake la jwenio ndi lya chakaka.
